name: claude-skills
description: Tyler Hughes' personal collection of Claude Code skills, distributed as a plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: working-style
plugins.description: Default operating style for any task: act when you have enough to act, ask only at real forks with 2–4 options and a recommendation first, build the least that works, find root causes, verify before claiming success, report briefly and honestly, and confirm before risky or outward-facing actions.

plugins.name: milestone-driven-development
plugins.description: How to run large, multi-part, or open-ended work: break it into shippable milestones, ask the user at real forks, verify each milestone for real before calling it done, commit as you go, delegate well-specified chunks to background subagents, and treat existing code and the user's request as having reasonable intent behind them.

plugins.name: reframework
plugins.description: Write, debug, and explain mods and scripts for REFramework (REF, by praydog) — the modding framework and scripting platform for Capcom RE Engine games (Resident Evil, Monster Hunter, Dragon's Dogma 2, Devil May Cry 5, Street Fighter 6, and more). Covers REFramework Lua scripting, the RE Engine type system and TDB, method hooking with sdk.hook, and the C++/C# plugin APIs.
